pkgmetadata.longdescription: STM32CubeIDE is an Eclipse based C/C++ integrated development environment for STM32 microcontrollers and microprocessors. It bundles the GNU toolchain for STM32, the STM32CubeProgrammer command line tools, the ST-LINK GDB server and a Java runtime.
STM32CubeIDE 是 ST 基于 Eclipse 的 C/C++ 集成开发环境，面向 STM32 微控制器与微处理器。它内置 STM32 的 GNU 工具链、STM32CubeProgrammer 命令行工具、ST-LINK GDB server 以及 Java 运行时。

use.flag: Install the SEGGER J-Link udev rules shipped with the installer
Install the stlink-server daemon that lets several applications share one ST-LINK probe
